Caddacaine is a strong inhibitor of HTX-8P, but Moroxetine is cleared almost entirely by HTX-3F. Since the inhibited enzyme (HTX-8P) is not the enzyme responsible for Moroxetine's clearance (HTX-3F), no inhibition-based pharmacokinetic interaction is expected. Moroxetine's high protein binding (92%) could theoretically allow a displacement interaction, but no protein-binding data are provided for Caddacaine, so this cannot be assessed; there is no evidence of such an effect here.

MECHANISM: Caddacaine inhibits HTX-8P; Moroxetine is cleared by HTX-3F — no shared pathway, so no inhibition interaction
